import argparse
import os
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    # Aliases for frequently used columns
    s1_enrolled = df['Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)']
    s1_approved = df['Curricular units 1st sem (approved)']
    s1_credited = df['Curricular units 1st sem (credited)']
    s1_evaluations = df['Curricular units 1st sem (evaluations)']
    s1_without = df['Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)']
    s1_grade = df['Curricular units 1st sem (grade)']

    # ASSERTION_START
    cond1 = (s1_approved <= s1_enrolled)
    cond2 = (s1_credited <= s1_enrolled)
    cond3 = (s1_without <= s1_enrolled)
    cond4 = (s1_evaluations >= s1_approved)
    cond5 = ((s1_approved + s1_without) <= s1_enrolled)
    cond6 = (~(s1_evaluations == 0) | (s1_approved == 0))
    cond7 = ((s1_grade >= 0) & (s1_grade <= 20))
    assert cond1.all() and cond2.all() and cond3.all() and cond4.all() and cond5.all() and cond6.all() and cond7.all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    s1_pass_rate_eval = np.where(s1_evaluations > 0, s1_approved / s1_evaluations, 0.0)
    s1_failed_count = s1_enrolled - s1_approved - s1_without
    s1_failed_ratio_enrolled = np.where(s1_enrolled > 0, s1_failed_count / s1_enrolled, 0.0)
    s1_credit_gap_ratio = np.where(s1_enrolled > 0, (s1_enrolled - s1_credited) / s1_enrolled, 0.0)
    s1_grade_norm = s1_grade / 20.0

    s2_enrolled = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)']
    s2_approved = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)']
    s2_credited = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (credited)']
    s2_evaluations = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (evaluations)']
    s2_without = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)']
    s2_grade = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)']

    # ASSERTION_START
    cond1 = (s2_approved <= s2_enrolled)
    cond2 = (s2_credited <= s2_enrolled)
    cond3 = (s2_without <= s2_enrolled)
    cond4 = (s2_evaluations >= s2_approved)
    cond5 = ((s2_approved + s2_without) <= s2_enrolled)
    cond6 = (~(s2_evaluations == 0) | (s2_approved == 0))
    cond7 = ((s2_grade >= 0) & (s2_grade <= 20))
    assert cond1.all() and cond2.all() and cond3.all() and cond4.all() and cond5.all() and cond6.all() and cond7.all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    s2_pass_rate_eval = np.where(s2_evaluations > 0, s2_approved / s2_evaluations, 0.0)
    s2_failed_count = s2_enrolled - s2_approved - s2_without
    s2_failed_ratio_enrolled = np.where(s2_enrolled > 0, s2_failed_count / s2_enrolled, 0.0)
    s2_credit_gap_ratio = np.where(s2_enrolled > 0, (s2_enrolled - s2_credited) / s2_enrolled, 0.0)
    s2_grade_norm = s2_grade / 20.0

    # ASSERTION_START
    zero_rate = (s2_without == 0).mean()
    assert zero_rate >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END

    debtor = df['Debtor']
    tuition_up_to_date = df['Tuition fees up to date']

    # ASSERTION_START
    c1 = ~((debtor == 1) & (tuition_up_to_date != 0))
    c2 = ~((tuition_up_to_date == 1) & (debtor != 0))
    c3 = (tuition_up_to_date == 1).mean() >= 0.85
    prop_debtor = (debtor == 1).mean()
    c4 = (prop_debtor >= 0.05) and (prop_debtor <= 0.20)
    assert c1.all() and c2.all() and c3 and c4
    # ASSERTION_END

    app_order = df['Application order']

    # ASSERTION_START
    within_bounds = (app_order >= 0) & (app_order <= 9)
    is_integer = (app_order == np.floor(app_order))
    p_one = (app_order == 1).mean()
    p_zero = (app_order == 0).mean()
    assert within_bounds.all() and is_integer.all() and (p_one >= 0.60) and (p_zero <= 0.005)
    # ASSERTION_END

    gdp = df['GDP']
    unemp = df['Unemployment rate']
    infl = df['Inflation rate']

    # ASSERTION_START
    allowed_gdp = {-4.06, -3.12, -1.7, -0.92, 0.32, 0.79, 1.74, 1.79, 2.02, 3.51}
    allowed_unemp = {7.6, 8.9, 9.4, 10.8, 11.1, 12.4, 12.7, 13.9, 15.5, 16.2}
    allowed_infl = {-0.8, -0.3, 0.3, 0.5, 0.6, 1.4, 2.6, 2.8, 3.7}
    gdp_key = gdp.round(2)
    unemp_key = unemp.round(1)
    infl_key = infl.round(1)
    a1 = gdp_key.isin(allowed_gdp)
    a2 = unemp_key.isin(allowed_unemp)
    a3 = infl_key.isin(allowed_infl)
    grp = pd.DataFrame({'g': gdp_key, 'u': unemp_key, 'i': infl_key})
    by_g = grp.groupby('g')
    u_counts = by_g['u'].nunique()
    i_counts = by_g['i'].nunique()
    a4 = (u_counts == 1).all() and (i_counts == 1).all()
    assert a1.all() and a2.all() and a3.all() and a4
    # ASSERTION_END

    unemp_norm = (unemp - unemp.min()) / (unemp.max() - unemp.min() if (unemp.max() - unemp.min()) != 0 else 1)
    infl_norm = (infl - infl.min()) / (infl.max() - infl.min() if (infl.max() - infl.min()) != 0 else 1)
    macro_stress = 0.5 * unemp_norm + 0.5 * infl_norm

    financial_risk = ((debtor == 1) | (tuition_up_to_date == 0)).astype(float)

    pass_component = np.maximum(1 - s1_pass_rate_eval, 1 - s2_pass_rate_eval)
    grade_component = 0.5 * (1 - s1_grade_norm) + 0.5 * (1 - s2_grade_norm)
    failed_density = np.where((s1_enrolled + s2_enrolled) > 0,
                              (s1_failed_count + s2_failed_count) / (s1_enrolled + s2_enrolled), 0.0)
    inactivity_component = (s2_without > 0).astype(float)
    application_component = (app_order != 1).astype(float)
    credit_gap_component = 0.5 * (s1_credit_gap_ratio + s2_credit_gap_ratio)

    risk_base = (
        0.35 * financial_risk +
        0.25 * pass_component +
        0.18 * grade_component +
        0.10 * failed_density +
        0.03 * inactivity_component +
        0.02 * application_component +
        0.07 * credit_gap_component
    )

    risk_score = np.clip(risk_base * (0.9 + 0.2 * macro_stress), 0.0, 1.0)
    at_risk = (risk_score >= 0.6) | (financial_risk == 1.0) | ((s1_pass_rate_eval < 0.5) | (s2_pass_rate_eval < 0.5))

    out_df = pd.DataFrame({
        'student_index': df.index,
        'risk_score': risk_score,
        'at_risk': at_risk.astype(int),
        'financial_risk': financial_risk.astype(int),
        'sem1_eval_pass_rate': s1_pass_rate_eval,
        'sem2_eval_pass_rate': s2_pass_rate_eval,
        'failed_units_total': (s1_failed_count + s2_failed_count),
        'application_order': app_order.astype(int),
        'GDP': gdp,
        'Unemployment rate': unemp,
        'Inflation rate': infl
    })

    out_csv = os.path.join(args.output, 'flagged_students.csv')
    out_df.to_csv(out_csv, index=False)

    summary = {
        'total_students': int(len(df)),
        'at_risk_count': int(at_risk.sum()),
        'at_risk_rate': float(at_risk.mean()),
        'financial_risk_count': int((financial_risk == 1.0).sum()),
        'inactive_sem2_count': int((s2_without > 0).sum())
    }
    with open(os.path.join(args.output, 'summary.json'), 'w') as f:
        json.dump(summary, f)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import argparse
import os
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    # Aliases for frequently used columns
    s1_enrolled = df['Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)']
    s1_approved = df['Curricular units 1st sem (approved)']
    s1_credited = df['Curricular units 1st sem (credited)']
    s1_evaluations = df['Curricular units 1st sem (evaluations)']
    s1_without = df['Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)']
    s1_grade = df['Curricular units 1st sem (grade)']

    # ASSERTION_START
    cond1 = (s1_approved <= s1_enrolled)
    cond2 = (s1_credited <= s1_enrolled)
    cond3 = (s1_without <= s1_enrolled)
    cond4 = (s1_evaluations >= s1_approved)
    cond5 = ((s1_approved + s1_without) <= s1_enrolled)
    cond6 = (~(s1_evaluations == 0) | (s1_approved == 0))
    cond7 = ((s1_grade >= 0) & (s1_grade <= 20))
    assert cond1.all() and cond2.all() and cond3.all() and cond4.all() and cond5.all() and cond6.all() and cond7.all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    s1_pass_rate_eval = np.where(s1_evaluations > 0, s1_approved / s1_evaluations, 0.0)
    s1_failed_count = s1_enrolled - s1_approved - s1_without
    s1_failed_ratio_enrolled = np.where(s1_enrolled > 0, s1_failed_count / s1_enrolled, 0.0)
    s1_credit_gap_ratio = np.where(s1_enrolled > 0, (s1_enrolled - s1_credited) / s1_enrolled, 0.0)
    s1_grade_norm = s1_grade / 20.0

    s2_enrolled = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)']
    s2_approved = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)']
    s2_credited = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (credited)']
    s2_evaluations = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (evaluations)']
    s2_without = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)']
    s2_grade = df['Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)']

    # ASSERTION_START
    cond1 = (s2_approved <= s2_enrolled)
    cond2 = (s2_credited <= s2_enrolled)
    cond3 = (s2_without <= s2_enrolled)
    cond4 = (s2_evaluations >= s2_approved)
    cond5 = ((s2_approved + s2_without) <= s2_enrolled)
    cond6 = (~(s2_evaluations == 0) | (s2_approved == 0))
    cond7 = ((s2_grade >= 0) & (s2_grade <= 20))
    assert cond1.all() and cond2.all() and cond3.all() and cond4.all() and cond5.all() and cond6.all() and cond7.all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    s2_pass_rate_eval = np.where(s2_evaluations > 0, s2_approved / s2_evaluations, 0.0)
    s2_failed_count = s2_enrolled - s2_approved - s2_without
    s2_failed_ratio_enrolled = np.where(s2_enrolled > 0, s2_failed_count / s2_enrolled, 0.0)
    s2_credit_gap_ratio = np.where(s2_enrolled > 0, (s2_enrolled - s2_credited) / s2_enrolled, 0.0)
    s2_grade_norm = s2_grade / 20.0

    # ASSERTION_START
    zero_rate = (s2_without == 0).mean()
    assert zero_rate >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END

    debtor = df['Debtor']
    tuition_up_to_date = df['Tuition fees up to date']

    # ASSERTION_START
    c1 = ~((debtor == 1) & (tuition_up_to_date != 0))
    c2 = ~((tuition_up_to_date == 1) & (debtor != 0))
    c3 = (tuition_up_to_date == 1).mean() >= 0.85
    prop_debtor = (debtor == 1).mean()
    c4 = (prop_debtor >= 0.05) and (prop_debtor <= 0.20)
    assert c1.all() and c2.all() and c3 and c4
    # ASSERTION_END

    app_order = df['Application order']

    # ASSERTION_START
    within_bounds = (app_order >= 0) & (app_order <= 9)
    is_integer = (app_order == np.floor(app_order))
    p_one = (app_order == 1).mean()
    p_zero = (app_order == 0).mean()
    assert within_bounds.all() and is_integer.all() and (p_one >= 0.60) and (p_zero <= 0.005)
    # ASSERTION_END

    gdp = df['GDP']
    unemp = df['Unemployment rate']
    infl = df['Inflation rate']

    # ASSERTION_START
    allowed_gdp = {-4.06, -3.12, -1.7, -0.92, 0.32, 0.79, 1.74, 1.79, 2.02, 3.51}
    allowed_unemp = {7.6, 8.9, 9.4, 10.8, 11.1, 12.4, 12.7, 13.9, 15.5, 16.2}
    allowed_infl = {-0.8, -0.3, 0.3, 0.5, 0.6, 1.4, 2.6, 2.8, 3.7}
    gdp_key = gdp.round(2)
    unemp_key = unemp.round(1)
    infl_key = infl.round(1)
    a1 = gdp_key.isin(allowed_gdp)
    a2 = unemp_key.isin(allowed_unemp)
    a3 = infl_key.isin(allowed_infl)
    grp = pd.DataFrame({'g': gdp_key, 'u': unemp_key, 'i': infl_key})
    by_g = grp.groupby('g')
    u_counts = by_g['u'].nunique()
    i_counts = by_g['i'].nunique()
    a4 = (u_counts == 1).all() and (i_counts == 1).all()
    assert a1.all() and a2.all() and a3.all() and a4
    # ASSERTION_END

    unemp_norm = (unemp - unemp.min()) / (unemp.max() - unemp.min() if (unemp.max() - unemp.min()) != 0 else 1)
    infl_norm = (infl - infl.min()) / (infl.max() - infl.min() if (infl.max() - infl.min()) != 0 else 1)
    macro_stress = 0.5 * unemp_norm + 0.5 * infl_norm

    financial_risk = ((debtor == 1) | (tuition_up_to_date == 0)).astype(float)

    pass_component = np.maximum(1 - s1_pass_rate_eval, 1 - s2_pass_rate_eval)
    grade_component = 0.5 * (1 - s1_grade_norm) + 0.5 * (1 - s2_grade_norm)
    failed_density = np.where((s1_enrolled + s2_enrolled) > 0,
                              (s1_failed_count + s2_failed_count) / (s1_enrolled + s2_enrolled), 0.0)
    inactivity_component = (s2_without > 0).astype(float)
    application_component = (app_order != 1).astype(float)
    credit_gap_component = 0.5 * (s1_credit_gap_ratio + s2_credit_gap_ratio)

    risk_base = (
        0.35 * financial_risk +
        0.25 * pass_component +
        0.18 * grade_component +
        0.10 * failed_density +
        0.03 * inactivity_component +
        0.02 * application_component +
        0.07 * credit_gap_component
    )

    risk_score = np.clip(risk_base * (0.9 + 0.2 * macro_stress), 0.0, 1.0)
    at_risk = (risk_score >= 0.6) | (financial_risk == 1.0) | ((s1_pass_rate_eval < 0.5) | (s2_pass_rate_eval < 0.5))

    out_df = pd.DataFrame({
        'student_index': df.index,
        'risk_score': risk_score,
        'at_risk': at_risk.astype(int),
        'financial_risk': financial_risk.astype(int),
        'sem1_eval_pass_rate': s1_pass_rate_eval,
        'sem2_eval_pass_rate': s2_pass_rate_eval,
        'failed_units_total': (s1_failed_count + s2_failed_count),
        'application_order': app_order.astype(int),
        'GDP': gdp,
        'Unemployment rate': unemp,
        'Inflation rate': infl
    })

    out_csv = os.path.join(args.output, 'flagged_students.csv')
    out_df.to_csv(out_csv, index=False)

    summary = {
        'total_students': int(len(df)),
        'at_risk_count': int(at_risk.sum()),
        'at_risk_rate': float(at_risk.mean()),
        'financial_risk_count': int((financial_risk == 1.0).sum()),
        'inactive_sem2_count': int((s2_without > 0).sum())
    }
    with open(os.path.join(args.output, 'summary.json'), 'w') as f:
        json.dump(summary, f)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
